days.title: Day 1: Isle of Skye, Highlands tour from Edinburgh - Inverness and welcome to Scotland!
days.description: The first journey of your tour is by train from Edinburgh to Inverness, accompanied by your Scottish guide. It’s a gentle introduction to the Scottish Highlands, with views of lochs, mountains and moors. After a lunchtime departure, you will arrive in Inverness in the afternoon, transferring to your accommodation via taxi. You’ll receive a warm Scottish welcome at Coul House Hotel. An historic, family-run Georgian mansion, Coul House will be your base for two nights as you get some Scottish Highlands experiences under your belt. For now, get settled in, admire the countryside views and Coul House’s garden, and raise a glass to the start of your vacation in Scotland.

days.title: Day 2: Cromarty - folklore, fortunes and fossils
days.description: After waking to a Highlands view and a hearty breakfast, you’ll be off to the nearby famous Black Isle peninsula, working your way up to the coastal town of Cromarty. On the way, we’ll stop in the town of Fortrose, known for its ruined cathedral and, with luck, see visiting dolphins from Chanonry Point!You’ll also hear the legend of the Brahan Seer, a 17th century prophet whose predictions brought him to an untimely end on the Point.Travelling on to Cromarty, we’ll visit the birthplace and childhood home of Hugh Miller, a pioneering Scottish geologist, folklorist and fossil hunter, whose life and discoveries are on prominent display in his preserved cottage, which is now a museum.We’ll take lunch in town, and after some more discovering, either take the ferry across to Tain to learn about Clan Ross, or travel back down the Black Isle to Beauly, home to the ruined 13th century priory and the renowned outfitters Campbell’s of Beauly.Back at Coul House, we’ll feast on a traditional group dinner, then relax ahead of the Skye leg of your Scotland vacation.

days.title: Day 3: Inverness to Skye - strongholds and incredible scenery
days.description: On the way to Skye, we’ll stop at a quintessentially Scottish landmark – Eilean Donan Castle.Standing where three lochs meet, the castle’s fascinating history began long before BBC branding and James Bond films made it famous! You’ll have plenty of time to wander the battlements and the castle halls and take lunch, before we hit the road and cross the bridge to Skye.We’ll travel up through Skye, encountering impressive landscapes on the way, such as the Fairy Pools and make our way to its northern Trotternish Peninsula. Along the way we’ll stop off at the Old Man of Storr, an iconic collection of rock pinnacles that is an internationally recognisable sign of the island. If time allows, we’ll also take in further sights in Skye’s north, including the equally spectacular Quiraing mountain landscapes and cliffs, that owe their origin to ancient volcanic activity.Travelling back down to Portree, we’ll end this day by checking into your accommodation on Skye, the four-star Cuillin Hills. This award-winning hotel has an equally commended restaurant, inviting bedrooms and some of the most remarkable loch and mountain views on Skye.

days.title: Day 4: Strathaird - sailing to a secluded loch
days.description: You’ll embark on a real Skye vacation adventure. We’ll head to a loch that’s notoriously hard to reach – if you travel there by land…luckily, you’ll be travelling by water! Board a boat in the village of Elgol to reach the elusive Loch Coruisk, which has stories of its own, having hosted Bonnie Prince Charlie while he evaded government capture after the Battle of Culloden. At the picturesque Loch Coruisk, you’ll find out about the area’s geological past and hear the story of the Highland Clearances, a key chapter in Scottish history. Afterwards, there will be a picnic lunch and time to take a short or an optional longer walk along the shoreline of this hidden gem. After getting the boat back to Elgol, we’ll return to Portree for a free afternoon and a last dinner at the Cuillin Hills Hotel.

days.title: Day 5: Skye to Appin - history, Hogwarts and heritage
days.description: After a last breakfast on Skye, it’s time to head off on the next leg of your Scotland vacation to Appin in Argyll. We’ll travel down to Skye’s southern coast and catch the ferry over to the town of Mallaig, before driving off to the Glenfinnan Viaduct. Famous for carrying the Hogwarts Express in the Harry Potter films, the area around the viaduct is also of great historical significance for being the landing point for Bonnie Prince Charlie in 1745, and the starting point of the Jacobite rising. Having taken in the sights and the history, we’ll journey onwards, stopping for lunch in Fort William before visiting Glen Coe, the mountainous site of a notorious massacre and an area of great geological interest, as well as one Darwin visited. The last stop before reaching your accommodation is Ballachulish Slate Quarry, where we’ll hear the story of continental collision to form the slates. Slates were once a vital industry for the area, and there is a linked story of a concerned doctor who campaigned for the area’s workers. Finally, you’ll check into the Pierhouse Hotel on the shores of Loch Linnhe, a welcoming hotel with excellent views and a menu dedicated to quality seafood.

days.title: Day 6: Appin - unwind on the Scottish Highland’s winding trails
days.description: After breakfast enjoying views of the loch from the Pierhouse Hotel, you’ll be spending today on the Island of Lismore, meeting retired geologist, Noelle Odling, who lives on Lismore. Noelle will guide you through the fascinating Island landscapes, history and geology, as well as giving you a unique and first-hand account of living on the Island. Noelle is the perfect guide as you visit castles, brochs, a medieval church, and the Heritage Centre. The journey to Lismore involves a short drive (40 mins) to Oban and a Ferry to Achnacroish with views of the dramatic mountains on the Isle of Mull.

days.title: Day 7: Returning home
days.description: Savour your last breakfast at the Pierhouse Hotel, then enjoy the journey back to Edinburgh around 9am via a scenic drive along the length of Loch Lomond. We’ll stop in Glasgow to catch the train back to Edinburgh, arriving at Waverley Station in the late afternoon. Alternatively, stay on in Glasgow for more adventures, or a flight home. Note: If required for reasons beyond our control, GeoCultura reserves the right to substitute alternative accommodation of equal or higher quality or adapt the itinerary if required.

title: Magical Skye and the Scottish Highlands
shortDescription: Explore the Scottish Highlands and the Isle of Skye from a Strathpeffer base with scenic excursions and the flexibility of a leisurely day or an optional trip to Ullapool.
vibe: Explore the Scottish Highlands and the Isle of Skye from a Strathpeffer base with scenic excursions and the flexibility of a leisurely day or an optional trip to Ullapool.

days.title: Day 1
days.description: Local departure by coach or Home Connect service, then on to Strathpeffer for a four-night stay.

days.title: Day 2 Fort Augustus, Loch Ness and Inverness
days.description: Enjoy a scenic trip along the banks of mysterious Loch Ness – be sure to have your camera ready in case you spot the infamous Nessie! We reach Fort Augustus at the southern tip of the loch. Here, you can sit and watch boats navigate the locks that connect it to the Caledonian Canal, or visit the Clansmen Centre where guides demonstrate traditional weaponry. We continue to visit Inverness, the 'capital' of the Highlands – a charming city situated at the top of the Great Glen. Why not stroll along the riverbanks, browse the Victorian Market, or soak up the Highlander hospitality in one of the cosy pubs?

days.title: Day 3 Isle of Skye and Eilean Donan Castle Viewpoint
days.description: After an early start, we travel from east to west, journeying through the spectacular scenery of the Scottish Highlands along part of the North Coast 500 route to reach the magical Isle of Skye. This is the second largest of Scotland's islands and undoubtedly the most beautiful, where the jagged mountain peaks, deep lochs and stunning coastline have been attracting visitors for centuries. We'll cross the magnificent Skye Bridge and take in the beautiful landscapes of this wonderful corner of Scotland.As we leave the island behind, we'll call in to admire the view of stunning Eilean Donan Castle before making our way back to Strathpeffer.

days.title: Day 4 Day at leisure or Ullapool
days.description: Enjoy a day to relax in the leafy Victorian spa town of Strathpeffer, where you can still drink water to treat all manner of ailments to this day. If you want to learn more about growing up in the Highlands, head to the Highland Museum of Childhood and uncover local history and traditions. Alternatively, why not join our optional excursion to Ullapool, a picturesque point on the North Coast 500 touring route? This quaint port village on the shores of Loch Broom has whitewashed cottages and a pretty harbour. Many of the buildings here date back hundreds of years, and outside the village there are still remnants of Iron Age settlements. Today, you can browse local crafts at the Harbour Gallery or Highland Stoneware, learn about fishing and crofting heritage at the museum, or simply enjoy watching boats come in and out of the harbour.

days.title: Day 5
days.description: Return home.

title: Scottish Highlands From Edinburgh - 5 days
shortDescription: Explore the breathtaking Scottish Highlands on a 5-day adventure from Edinburgh, featuring stunning landscapes, historic castles, and charming villages.
vibe: Explore the breathtaking Scottish Highlands on a 5-day adventure from Edinburgh, featuring stunning landscapes, historic castles, and charming villages.

days.title: Day 1: Edinburgh
days.description: Edinburgh - Dunkeld - Cairngorms National Park - Loch Ness - Ullapool. Setting off from Edinburgh this morning, our first stop is in the charming highland village of Dunkeld. We then pass through the ancient pine forests of the Cairngorms National Park to Loch Ness. Scotland's most famous loch is allegedly home to a fearsome monster. Keep your eyes peeled as we have some free time to look for Nessie!We then complete our drive to Ullapool, a pretty whitewashed fishing village on the edge of Loch Broom.Please note: Check-in closes at 08:45 on day 1 (tour departs at 09:00) - Edinburgh Bus Station Pick Up, Gate J and Gate K, inside Edinburgh Bus Station, St Andrew Square, Edinburgh, EH1 3DQ.Accommodation: Foinaven, Ullaviews, The Sheiling Guest House or similar

days.title: Day 2: Ullapool
days.description: On today's day trip from Ullapool, we take in some of the north-west Scottish Highlands. Admire views of the mountains of Assynt and visit the 15th century ruins of Ardvreck Castle, which was once home to a powerful clan, the MacLeods of Assynt. We also see the picturesque white beach at Achmelvich Bay and the traditional fishing settlement of Lochinver, before returning to Ullapool for the evening. Accommodation: Foinaven, Ullaviews, The Sheiling Guest House or similar

days.title: Day 3: Skye
days.description: Ullapool - Applecross - Plockton - Skye. Leaving Ullapool behind, our first stop today is the Corrieshalloch Gorge, where we can see the River Droma plunge 60 metres over a precipice. We then drive past the mountains of the Beinn Eighe nature reserve and skirt around Loch Torridon. We stop for lunch in Applecross before taking one of Scotland's most scenic drives, Bealach na B, a twisting single track road.We also make a stop in 'tropical' Plockton, where the palm trees rising on the edge of Loch Carron look slightly out of place. After a short visit, we make our way to the coast and board the ferry to the Isle of Skye. We're staying in the harbour town of Portree.Accommodation: Caledonian, Duirinish, Dunborrodale or similar

days.title: Day 4: Skye
days.description: Today we will be exploring the remote Isle of Skye, but there is no fixed itinerary for the day. The weather can be unpredictable, so your guide will choose the best highlights to show you in accordance with the conditions and any events that may be happening on the island during your visit. We are likely to be hiking, in order to enjoy the dramatic scenery of the island. Options include The Quiraing hill walk and the Old Man of Storr Walk, probably the most famous trail on the island. We can also see the Neist Point Lighthouse. Spend the day taking photos, sampling the view and enjoying everything this pristine environment has to offer. In the late afternoon, we return to our accommodation.Accommodation: Caledonian, Duirinish, Dunborrodale or similar

days.title: Day 5: Fort William
days.description: Skye - Eilean Donan Castle - Fort William - Glencoe - Edinburgh. Leaving Skye, we travel by land to Eilean Donan Castle, a 13th century fortress, located on an island. We then journey south through Glen Garry and past Britain's highest mountain, Ben Nevis. There's a stop for lunch in Fort William and we visit Glencoe in the afternoon. This picturesque area hides a turbulent history, as it was the location of the 1692 Glencoe Massacre. Around 30 members of Clan MacDonald of Glencoe were slaughtered here for failing to pledge allegiance to King William III and Mary II. After our visit of Glencoe, we return to Edinburgh, where our tour ends.Please note: This tour ends at 19:00 - Edinburgh Bus Station Drop Off, Gate J and Gate K, Edinburgh Bus Station, St Andrew Square, Edinburgh, EH1 3DQ.

title: 3-day Skye and Inverness
shortDescription: Explore Skye, Inverness, and Loch Ness on a 3-day driver-guided Scottish Highlands adventure with overnights in Inverness.
vibe: Explore Skye, Inverness, and Loch Ness on a 3-day driver-guided Scottish Highlands adventure with overnights in Inverness.

days.title: Day 1: A Spectacular Route North…
days.description: Depart Edinburgh or Glasgow and travel via Loch Lomond & The Trossachs National Park with a village stop and views of Loch Lomond. Continue across Rannoch Moor and through Glen Coe, hearing about the MacDonald Clan massacre, then reach Fort William for a lunch stop with views of Ben Nevis. Overnight in Inverness.

days.title: Day 2: A full day on the incredible Isle of Skye…
days.description: Spend a full day on Skye with your guide, taking in the Cuillin Mountains. Explore the Trotternish Peninsula with photo stops at Kilt Rock, Mealt Waterfall and the Old Man of Storr, and pause for lunch in Portree. Overnight in Inverness.

days.title: Day 3: Explore Urquhart Castle perched on the edge of Loch Ness…
days.description: Visit Loch Ness and Urquhart Castle, with the option to take a Jacobite cruise. Continue to Culloden Battlefield and visitor centre, then travel south via Pitlochry and end in Edinburgh city centre.

title: Treasures of Indochina 15 Days - Vietnam, Thailand, Cambodia, Laos
shortDescription: Discover the cultural charms of Vietnam, Thailand, Cambodia, and Laos within 15 days.
vibe: Discover the cultural charms of Vietnam, Thailand, Cambodia, and Laos within 15 days.

days.title: Day 1: Welcome to Vietnam - Hanoi Arrival
days.description: Upon arrival, your driver will meet and greet you at the airport. Enjoy a transfer from the airport to your accommodation. Check-in at the hotel and have a rest after the flight. Overnight in Hanoi.

days.title: Day 2: Lost in Paradise (B/L)- Hoa Lu Tam Coc
days.description: Our guide & driver will pick you up at your hotel in Hanoi Old Quarter, then leave by coach to Hoa Lu (2.5 hrs). Visit the historic capital of Vietnam and the famous ancient temples of Le and the Dinh Dynasties. Then our bus will transfer you from Hoa Lu to Tam Coc for lunch around at 12:30 PM. PM: After lunch, boat trip to visit Tam Coc to see the beauty of the karst formations as you pass along their base and row into one of the many caves carved through the limestone. Then, cycle for an hour on quiet roads through villages, rice fields, rivers and rocky outcrops in Tam Coc - Bich Dong (around 5 km). Dive back to Hanoi and drop off at your hotel around at 18:30 PM. Overnight in Hanoi

days.title: Day 3: Hanoi - Halong Bay - Overnight on Cruise (B/L/D)
days.description: Have a hearty breakfast at your hotel and check out from hotel. Our English-speaking guide and driver will pick-up and transfer to Halong Bay. On the way, take the most scenic route to reach Halong Bay, taking you across the Red River Delta with emerald green rice paddies stretching for as far as the eyes can. On arrival, we embark a beautiful traditional junk and spend a full day and night cruising the bay’s 3000 magnificent limestone islets. Experience to kayak on the gently water and admire crystal clear water with a thousand islands rising on the water with diversity of flora and fauna. In the evening when the boat is anchored in the middle of the stunning lagoon and the sun gradually goes down, we enjoy a mouthwatering seafood meal and participate in some shore excursion on boat. Spend the night on the luxury boat. Overnight on cruise

days.title: Day 4: Halong Bay - Hanoi (B/L)- Sharing Bus, Sharing Cruise
days.description: Wake-up at early and breathe the laidback - atmosphere on cruise, you’ll have a Tai Chi lesson on the sundeck and enjoy the breakfast, you’ll have an amazing time exploring the stunning cave, full of stalagmites and stalactites. From here, it’s clear sailing back to the harbor and back to Hanoi around 4:30 pm. We’ll drop you off at your hotel and enjoy the free time in Hanoi

days.title: Day 5: Travel From Hanoi to Ho Chi Minh City (B)
days.description: Have a hearty breakfast at your hotel and you can explore the Hanoi at your own pace. Afterwards, our driver will come to your hotel and transfer to the airport. Take a flight to Ho Chi Minh City, upon arrival in Tan Son Nhat International Airport, our driver escorts you to your hotel. Check-in your hotel.

days.title: Day 6: Mekong Delta and Cu Chi Tunnel (B/L)
days.description: Our driver and an English-speaking guide will pick you up in your hotel and depart for Cu Chi Tunnels. There you will gain insight about living conditions of Vietnamese resistance fighters known as Viet Cong during the Vietnam War and sneak-peek the extensive tunnels to admire the complex system of water drainage and ventilation holes. After that, you will depart for My Tho which is in the Mekong Delta area. Cruising along the leisure waterway and jungle, visit Dragon, Unicorn, and Phoenix and Tortoise islands. Navigating the bamboo boat in the calm water channel to observe the local lives and revel in the tranquility that you might have never experienced before. Continuing the rowboat trip you can appreciate the cultural diversity in this region when crossing the fruit orchards, coconut groves, etc. You can also take this chance to sample some newly-picked fruits and fresh coconut candy while sipping a cup of honey tea. Finally, transfer back to Ho Chi Minh City and the tour ends around 18:00.Overnight in Ho Chi Minh City

days.title: Day 7: Travel From Ho Chi Minh City to Siem Reap (B)
days.description: Have a hearty breakfast at your hotel and you can explore Ho Chi Minh City at your own pace. Afterward, our driver will come to your hotel and transfer you to the airport. Take a flight to Siem Reap, upon arrival at Siem Reap International Airport, our driver escorts you to your hotel. Check-in at your hotel.

days.title: Day 8: Explore The Magnificent Angkor Temples (B)
days.description: Breakfast at the hotel. Visit Angkor Thom, the South Gate of Angkor Thom, Bayon Temple, built from the late 12th century to the early 13th century by King Jayavarman VII and consists of 54 towers, the Royal Enclosure, the Phimeanakas, the Elephants Terrace and the Terrace of the Leper King, then visit Ta Prohm, surrounded by jungle. Visit Angkor Wat, the largest temple in the world and covers an area of 200 hectares and is surrounded by a moat and an exterior wall measuring 1300 meters x 1500 meters. Early this evening, we will take the Tuk Tuk (the most common taxi in Cambodia) to cruise around Siem Reap town and for a blessing ceremony by Buddhist monks for happiness, prosperity, and safety for your journey. Overnight at the hotel in Siem Reap

days.title: Day 9: Explore the Local Life on Tonle Sap Lake (B)
days.description: After breakfast, visit to Floating Village, take a ride by traditional wooden boat on Tonle Sap Lake to experience the human occupations at the edges of the lake is similarly distinctive – floating villages, towering stilted houses, huge fish traps, and an economy and way of life deeply intertwined with the lake, the fish, the wildlife and the cycles of rising and falling waters. In the wet season, the Tonle Sap Lake is one of the largest freshwater lakes in Asia. Afternoon, We will drive to the Pouk district about 15 Km in the West of Siem Reap town you visit the silk farm, a fascinating farm/workshop where you can see the entire silk creation process including growing the food for the silk worms, breeding the worms, silk extraction and refinement, traditional kit dying pattern creation and looming. Retail silk and souvenir shop. On the way back, visit the Western Baray (Baray Occidental) measuring 8 km by 2.3 km which provided water for the intensive cultivation of lands around Angkor. Overnight at the hotel in Siem Reap

days.title: Day 10: Travel From Siem Reap to Bangkok (B)
days.description: Have a hearty breakfast at your hotel and you can explore Siem Reap at your own pace. Afterward, our driver will come to your hotel and transfer you to the airport. Take a flight to Bangkok, upon arrival at Bangkok International Airport, our driver escorts you to your hotel. Check-in at your hotel.Overnight in Bangkok

days.title: Day 11: Bangkok Floating Market and City Tour (B/L)
days.description: Have breakfast at your hotel. 07.30 AM. Meet the English guide at the hotel lobby. Let's start with the Railway Track Market (Rom Hoop Market) commonly also called Siang Tai Market (life-threatening). the market is located on the railway near Mae Klong railway station. Proceed to the Damnen Saduak Floating Market, we arrive at the pier and with a long tail boat in about 30-45 minutes through the canals, we reach the Floating Market. Arrive at the market and enjoy local Thai products, and Thai Foods at about 12.00 AM. Transfer back to Bangkok.Lunch at a local restaurant. In the afternoon, this tour takes you through the hustle and bustle of Bangkok to visit two of the capital’s most significant and visually stunning temples. Wat Traimit houses the world’s largest solid gold Buddha (5.5 tons of precious metal) and Wat Pho, which is the oldest temple in Bangkok and houses of the Reclining Buddha, a 45-meter-long statue which depicts Buddha entering Nirvana. Wat Pho is also Thailand s first university and houses a wealth of art. It is still an important center for traditional medicine and massage. Continue to Wat Benjamabophit, also known as the marble temple featuring a fusing of Thai and European styles and an ubosot covered by Italian marble.Overnight in Bangkok( Meal : Breakfast and Lunch)

days.title: Day 12: Bangok Free and Easy (B)
days.description: Some free days you can use for taking optional tours, or just strolling around Bangkok for handicrafts and souvenirs, or maybe have yourself a spa treatment? Overnight in Bangkok

days.title: Day 13: Travel From Bangkok to Luang Prabang (B) - Optional Chiang Mai Extension
days.description: Have a hearty breakfast at your hotel and you can explore Bangkok at your own pace. Afterward, our driver will come to your hotel and transfer you to the airport. Take a flight to Luang Prabang, upon arrival at Luang Prabang International Airport, our driver escorts you to your hotel. Check-in at your hotel.Overnight in Luang PrabangOPTIONAL - CHIANG MAI EXTENSION Take an optional to Chiang Mai if you want to explore the highland of Thaland - Chiang MaiDAY 1: TRAVEL FROM FROM BANGKOK TO CHIANG MAIHave a hearty breakfast at your hotel and you can explore Bangkok at your own pace. Afterward, our driver will come to your hotel and transfer you to the airport. Take a flight to Chiang Mai, upon arrival at Chiang Mai International Airport, our driver escorts you to your hotel. Check-in at your hotel.Overnight in Chiang MaiDAY 2: CHIANG MAI TEMPLE TOUR (B/L)Breakfast. Pick up by your guide for a full day “safari” city tour of Chiang Mai by using different modes of transportation (the songthaew, long tail boat, tuk tuk). Start with a stroll in the old traders’ community at Wat Gatekaram before heading to Wiang Kum Kam, the ancient city in ruins. Tour the small village by tram. Head to Wat Chedi Luang, where we make offers to the monks and receive their blessing. Continue uphill to the Wat Phrathat Doi Suthep, not only for its view but also to be involved in a blessing ceremony or witness the chanting of the monks. Return to the hotel.Overnight Chiang MaiDAY 3: CHIANG MAI ELEPHANT SANCTUARY TOUR (B/L)Breakfast. Spend the day at an Elephant Rescue Park (join basis). Morning pick up and join the transfer to the sanctuary. Arrive at the sanctuary and get briefed on the day’s activities for your one-on-one interactions with the rescued elephants. You will get to meet them, feed them, walk with them, hug them, play with them, bath with them. Enjoy the memorable day and transfer back to your hotel in the afternoon.Overnight Chiang MaiDAY 4: TRAVEl FRoM CHIANG MAI TO LUANG PRABANG (B)

days.title: Day 14: Pak Ou Cave and Kuangsi Waterfall (B/L)
days.description: An optional early start gives you the fantastic opportunity to participate in the daily morning rituals of saffron-clad monks collecting offerings of Alms (ubiquitous sticky rice) from the faithful residents. This tradition is very unique in Laos, being the only Buddhist nation still preserving the procession. AM: After breakfast, we enjoy a short-guided tour seeing the city’s oldest temple of Wat Sene and the magnificent Wat Xiengthong with its roofs sweeping low to the ground, which represents classical Laotian architecture. We then board a cruise upstream on the Mekong River, which also gives us a panaromic view of the tranquil countryside as well as an interesting visit to the mysterious of Pak Ou Caves, two linked caves crammed with thousands of gold lacquered Buddha statues of various shapes and sizes left by pilgrims. Along the way, we stop at the small village of Ban Xanghai, where the local rice wine is distilled. We return to Luang Prabang in the afternoon, on the way we take a short drive to Ban Phanom, a small village well known for its hand weaving. PM: We continue our excursion toward Khouangsi Waterfall, en route, we visit local villages of Lao ethnic minority groups at Ban Ouay, Hmong Village, Ban Ou, Laoloum Village and Ban Thapene, Khmu Village, then drive to the beautiful Khouangsi Waterfall where you can splash around in the turquoise pools or walk along the forest trails. We return to Luang Prabang by late afternoon and continue to Ban Xangkhong, a village well known for silk handweaving and for traditional Saa Paper making. We return to the city by late evening to observe the sunset at Wat Siphouthabath. Overnight in Luang Prabang

days.title: Day 15: Time To Say Goodbye - Luang Prabang Departure (B)
days.description: Today is the day that most travelers hated. It is one of those days when they have to leave and back to reality. Our driver will pick you up at the hotel and take you to the airport to catch your flight back home. See you soon again on your next Prestigo Asia experience. We wish you a nice trip home.
